15 reactions | 🇧🇫  JNIM is major al-Qaeda aligned militant umbrella coalition that exerts a dominant and expanding armed presence across large swathes of rural Burkina Faso.

JNIM was formed in March 2017 through the merger of several jihadist groups (including Ansar al-Din, Al-Qaeda in the Islamic Maghreb, Al-Mourabitoun, and Katibat Macina) under the leadership of Iyad Ag Ghali.

JNIM has established deep rural dominance, embedding itself across northern, eastern, and central regions of Burkina Faso, and operating heavily in border zones.

The group relies heavily on ambush-centric warfare, improvised explosive devices (IEDs), targeted assassinations, and systematic equipment or vehicle seizures against national security forces and civilian auxiliary units (such as VDPs).

JNIM is engaged in a bitter turf and ideological war with its main jihadist rival, the Islamic State – Sahel Province (ISGS/ISSP), which also operates across the tri-border areas of Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger.

Video - The JNIM captured an outpost of the pro-government VDP militia in the town of Bani in the Seno region of Burkina Faso. | Israel Today
